sql: CREATE TABLE nvr_devices (id TEXT PRIMARY KEY, document TEXT NOT NULL); CREATE TABLE nvr_policy (id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY CHECK(id=1), document TEXT NOT NULL); CREATE TABLE nvr_runs (id TEXT PRIMARY KEY, document TEXT NOT NULL); CREATE TABLE nvr_segments (id TEXT PRIMARY KEY, device_id TEXT NOT NULL, started_at TEXT NOT NULL, ended_at TEXT NOT NULL, status TEXT NOT NULL, size_bytes INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, document TEXT NOT NULL); CREATE INDEX nvr_segments_timeline ON nvr_segments(device_id,started_at); CREATE INDEX nvr_segments_cleanup ON nvr_segments(status,ended_at); CREATE TABLE nvr_events (id TEXT PRIMARY KEY, device_id TEXT NOT NULL, occurred_at TEXT NOT NULL, unique_key TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE, document TEXT NOT NULL); CREATE INDEX nvr_events_timeline ON nvr_events(device_id,occurred_at);
